patches.reason: Revalidate the effective Buddy ownership contract before constructing either XiaoZhi listener.
Blank the upstream shared weather API key because it is unsafe for redistribution in this repository.
Validate Buddy local and merged configuration before remote selection, directory setup, or cache reuse.
Register and remove immutable Buddy session identity, preserve invocation-local dialogue snapshots, and bypass upstream tools and manager title persistence in Buddy mode.
Record a best-effort bounded abort event after the native abort path completes without taking ownership of speech cleanup.
Prevent device-advertised MCP initialization in Buddy mode while retaining the upstream path outside Buddy mode.
Record best-effort TTS lifecycle events after the existing native send path has emitted its control message.
Record best-effort listen lifecycle events at the owning text handler without reparsing frames or changing turn decisions.
Expose bounded local diagnostics through the existing SimpleHttpServer alongside the native OTA routes without creating another HTTP process.
Preserve typed ASR provider failures through the native voice-stop boundary, guard stale callbacks by invocation generation, and otherwise retain native ASR lifecycle ownership.
Preserve native Qwen provider failures as typed outcomes and pass configured endpoint and timeout to the DashScope SDK compatibility gate.
Notify the connection lifecycle hook only after final native TTS retry exhaustion or the existing worker catch, without duplicating queue or playback control.
Provide a neutral native prompt template so Buddy Core remains the sole persona and prompt owner.
Add the minimal Buddy integration package required to keep Task 4 provider failures separate from valid silence.

Validate the Buddy production ownership contract after configuration merge, including the actual context-provider, voiceprint, and neutral-prompt runtime keys, and reject local remote-manager settings before any remote fetch.
Provide a bounded, redacted in-process lifecycle registry for XiaoZhi's existing SimpleHttpServer debug endpoints without IPC or speech queues.
Define typed public ASR provider failures so upstream ASR errors are not converted to empty recognition.
Provide the immutable, lock-protected per-connection identity registry used by the Buddy Core LLM provider.
Provide a loopback-only deterministic ASR provider used exclusively by the gated fault-recovery test runtime.
Add the compatibility-authorized Qwen chat-completions ASR provider for the configured endpoint after native DashScope returned HTTP 404.
Add the Buddy Core LLM provider package to the native XiaoZhi provider layout.
Route a current user turn with immutable connection metadata to the local Buddy Core OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
Add the configured Qwen HTTP TTS provider through the native flat loader while leaving upstream audio queueing, encoding, playback, and abort handling unchanged.
